text: CI costs less. The account's GitHub Actions minutes ran out after one day of 95 runs and about 1,317 minutes, mostly full runs on main for docs-only changes. Now a change that touches only docs and decisions skips CI, and a newer push to the same branch cancels a run that's still going. A factory pull request's gate verifies the one project it changes, since scope already confines it there. The gate's own tests run on pull requests that can change the gate, and not again on main. @gitdek chose this, and chose to merge it without CI as a one-time exception, since CI can't run until the repository goes public. The whole suite passed locally first.
